Some early evidence that AI may actually be accelerating discoveries in the areas where you would expect to see AI acceleration happening first.

there's a free, open-source tool that turns a single keyword into a finished short-form video.

script, voiceover, subtitles, and footage, all in one run.

it's called MoneyPrinterTurbo. someone built it as an open-source project and it's now past 100,000 stars on GitHub.

it https://t.co/XnbwFxRifr
2 things worth knowing. it runs on your own API keys, so "free" means the tool, not always the usage. and it assembles stock footage, so the output is only as good as the idea you feed it.

a tool can stitch the clips. it can't tell you what will make someone stop scrolling. that part, the idea and the 3-second hook, is a prompt problem.

here's the free prompt that spins up 10 short-form video concepts built to stop the scroll:
https://t.co/KKrBhoFF58

the rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

follow if you want the AI to make the video and the ideas that make it worth watching.
